description:
● Pedal-free beginner bike allows child to focus on balance
● Rubber air tires for a smooth ride
● Tool-free adjustable comfort seat grows with your child
● Grip-tape footrest on frame for no-slip safety
● Real ringing bell for added fun

Radio Flyer’s Air Ride Balance Bike is the ideal tool to help beginners learn how to ride! This pedal-free beginner bike allows your child to focus on balance, preparing them for a two-wheeler in no time. Avoid wobbly and frustrating training wheels altogether! The Air Ride Balance Bike features rubber air tires that hug the road and a sturdy steel frame for durability. The whitewall tires add to the classic design. The comfort seat adjusts to grow with your child and the ringing bell offers additional fun! It also features grip tape on the frame to provide no-slip safety for your child’s feet as they glide. Maximum weight capacity 50 lbs. For ages 1 ½ - 5 years.
